content:
kayla_cs: Quick heads-up: Sirius preview kickoff next Wed. Need final enroll list + 1-line use case + top risk per account by Mon EOD. Put in https://docs.google.com/sheets/sirius-enroll (do NOT change header row).

ravi_csm: Uploading my cohort now. Two customers require SSO, one wants an IP allowlist.

mina_enable: I'll run a 20-min admin walk during each kickoff to collect IdP metadata and demo settings. Can someone capture preferred trace windows?

jorge_eng: For token traces we can enable 12-24h windows only. Longer requires approval due to costs. Also please collect 3 canonical prompts per customer for evals.

infra-kim: IP allowlist ok; need CIDR + expected RPS. If >50 RPS sustained, we'll provision extra capacity.

ravi_csm: Noted; adding RPS & CIDR columns. Also flagging one account as procurement_pending under "trial_blocker".

kayla_cs: Add two columns: "success_metric" and "risk_summary". Also a boolean "ok_to_share_sanitized_notes" so we can reuse anonymized feedback. Fill by Mon EOD.

mina_enable: Drafting the 3-question Day7 survey and a Day14 interview guide. Will drop in the drive by Friday.

jorge_eng: I'll prepare the eval harness and a small script to pull traces when windows are enabled. Share runbook in #eng-releases.

notify-bot: Reminder set: "Sirius enroll list due" on Mon 17:00 UTC.

kayla_cs: Thanks all. Minimal rollout checklist: confirm list (CS), collect IdP + RPS + prompts (CS), assign trace windows (CS + Infra), enablement session (Enablement), eval harness ready (Eng), risk flags + mitigation (CS). Update sheet as you complete items.
